description: Deterministic Rego rule engine violation patterns (local, no API). A case is a violation (verdict=1) if any event matches (syscall, resource-substring). Source: experiments/rq2/jury_quality.py (RegoRuleEngine.VIOLATION_PATTERNS).
match_rule: event.syscall == syscall AND pattern in event.resource
note: This is the deterministic anchor that breaks LLM collective hallucination; it is architecturally orthogonal to the two LLM jurors.
